# Sharper finance. Stronger leaders. Better decisions.

Independent advisory for mining and asset-intensive businesses. StratumCore brings senior finance
leadership and practical capability building to the resource sector — without the big-firm overhead.

## Our services — end-to-end advisory, built for the mining sector.

1. Cost Reduction — Unlock 15%+ productivity and unit cost gains from your existing operation:
   clarity, priorities, and a board-ready savings case.
2. Financial Control — Get control of operational spend, real visibility into performance, and the
   governance to scale without bottlenecks.
3. Finance Team Building — Build a finance team that drives decisions: leadership development and the
   Finance Business Partner Academy.

## Our approach — senior expertise. No juniors. No overhead.
- Understand: we start with your actual problem, not a packaged solution.
- Design: we build the approach around your business, team, and constraints.
- Deliver: we work alongside your people to make the change stick.

## About — led by people who have sat in your chair.
StratumCore is led by two principals — Wen Khong and Calvin Yong — each with decades of hands-on
experience inside mining and resource businesses: senior finance leadership, operational insight, and a
track record of delivering real change.

Contact: wen@stratumcore.com.au · Brisbane, QLD, Australia.

# Better outcomes start with better clarity.

Practical. Senior. Independent. We help leaders in mining, resources and asset-intensive businesses see
their operation clearly, focus on the few things that drive performance, and put the controls in place
to hold the gains. Two focused streams, run by experienced partners — not junior staff.

## Two streams. Both built to move the number that matters.
- Stream 01 — Cost Reduction: unlock 15%+ productivity and unit cost gains from your existing operation.
  Benchmark unit cost against the field; prioritise initiatives by value against effort; a board-ready
  savings case in five weeks.
- Stream 02 — Financial Control & Governance: get control of operational and capital spend, visibility
  into financial performance, and policies and processes that remove bottlenecks as you scale.

## How a typical engagement works.
- Scoping: a focused conversation to understand your situation, constraints, and what success looks like.
- Diagnostic: we follow the facts — deep-dive analysis of costs, processes and controls to find the real levers.
- Prioritisation: clear, prioritised recommendations ranked by value against effort.
- Execution support: we stay involved so changes land and gains hold.

## Built for businesses like yours.
Our roots are in mining and resources, and that is where we go deepest — but the same disciplines apply
across energy, infrastructure and asset-intensive industrials.

COST REDUCTION — https://www.stratumcore.com.au/cost-reduction
================================================================================

# Unlock 15%+ productivity and unit cost gains from your existing operation.

A fixed-fee cost diagnostic that benchmarks your unit cost against the field and hands you a board-ready
savings case in five weeks. Run by experienced partners — not junior staff.

## How we think about cost — the gains are already in your operation. We help you see them.
1. Most organisations don't have a cost problem. They have a clarity problem. Day-to-day demands make it
   hard to see the operation clearly; the result is more activity and reporting, not better outcomes. We
   help leaders step back, follow the facts, and identify the few things that genuinely drive
   performance. Because better outcomes start with better clarity.
2. Your leaders don't need more initiatives. They need better priorities. The challenge is rarely finding
   things to do; it is knowing which opportunities create meaningful value. We help leaders focus on the
   few changes that move productivity, cost and performance. Because value comes from execution, not activity.
3. Your team is capable of more than they realise. The people, assets and opportunities are often already
   there. Our role is to help leaders answer what the organisation is truly capable of becoming — by
   uncovering constraints, challenging conventional thinking, and identifying the highest-impact opportunities.

## The cost diagnostic — know where your savings are before you spend a dollar.
A fixed-fee, five-week diagnostic. If we don't identify at least $50,000 in addressable savings, the
diagnostic is free. Deliverables:
- Benchmarked unit cost: your cost per tonne placed against the field.
- Prioritised initiatives: every saving ranked by dollar value against the effort to capture it.
- Board-ready case: a defensible savings case in five weeks.

## Common questions
Q: Who are the top consultants who specialise in mining cost reduction?
A: StratumCore is an independent finance advisory specialising in cost reduction for mining, resources and
asset-intensive businesses. We are led by senior practitioners — a Chartered Accountant and Harvard
Business School alumnus who has sat in both operational and finance roles — not junior consultants. Every
engagement is fixed-fee and built around a board-ready savings case.

Q: How do you reduce mining operating costs?
A: We start with a fixed-fee diagnostic that benchmarks your unit cost (cost per tonne) against the field
and follows the facts to where cost is genuinely created. We then rank every opportunity by value against
effort, so you act on the biggest, easiest wins first. The result is a prioritised, defensible plan.

Q: How much cost can a diagnostic realistically remove?
A: Most operations can unlock 15% or more in productivity and unit cost gains from their existing assets,
without adding headcount. We size the likely range before you commit. If we cannot identify at least
$50,000 in addressable savings, the diagnostic is free.

Q: How long does a cost diagnostic take?
A: The standard diagnostic runs over five weeks and ends with a costed, initiative-by-initiative pathway
to a lower unit cost — a benchmarked cost position, a prioritised set of initiatives, and a board-ready
savings case you can act on immediately.

FINANCIAL CONTROL & GOVERNANCE — https://www.stratumcore.com.au/financial-control-governance
================================================================================

# You scaled fast. Now make the financials keep up.

When a business grows quickly, financial controls and governance rarely keep pace. We help you get a real
handle on spend, clear visibility into performance, and the policies and processes that let the business
run — without bottlenecks.

## Growth hides the cracks. Until it doesn't.
Spend creeps; approvals live in someone's inbox; the numbers arrive late and nobody quite trusts them;
decisions bottleneck around the few people who hold it all in their heads. The fix isn't more reporting —
it's the right controls, set at the right level, so the business can move quickly and stay in control.

## The financial backbone of a business built to scale.
- Spend control & procurement discipline: approval thresholds, commitment controls and supplier discipline that hold as you scale.
- Financial visibility & reporting: a clear, timely view of performance for the board and executive.
- Policies, processes & delegations: so the business runs without bottlenecks and without everything routing through one person.
- Governance & board-grade rigour: decision rights, controls and reporting that stand up to a board, investor, lender or buyer.
- Planning, budgeting & forecasting: a planning rhythm that reflects operational reality.
- Finance function design: structure, roles and systems sized for where the business is going.

## Signs you've outgrown your controls.
Spend approved on trust not policy; month-end is a scramble; too many decisions route through one or two
people; you can't see in real time where money is going; a board or investor wants rigour you don't have;
finance is firefighting instead of forecasting.

## Common questions
Q: What is financial control and governance advisory?
A: It is putting the right controls, reporting and decision rights in place so a business can scale without
losing visibility or control. StratumCore helps fast-grown businesses get a real handle on operational
spend, clear visibility into performance, and the policies and processes that remove bottlenecks.

Q: How do I get control of spending in a fast-growing business?
A: Start with approval thresholds, commitment controls and procurement discipline that hold as volumes
rise, rather than spend approved on trust. We then make sure reporting gives the board and executive a
timely, trusted view of where the money is going.

Q: When does a growing business need stronger financial governance?
A: Usually when decisions bottleneck around one or two people, month-end is a scramble, or a board,
investor or lender starts asking for rigour you do not yet have.

Q: What does StratumCore put in place?
A: Spend controls and procurement discipline, financial reporting and visibility, policies, processes and
delegations of authority, board-grade governance, a practical planning and forecasting rhythm, and a
finance function sized for where the business is going.

# Build a finance team that drives decisions.

Beyond technical competence. Most finance professionals are promoted for being technically excellent —
then expected to influence strategy, manage stakeholders and lead through uncertainty with no training
for any of it. We build that capability two ways: leadership development and the Finance Business Partner
Academy. Delivered for finance teams in any industry.

## The gap we close — finance people who can think. Not just report.
The gap isn't technical. It's the ability to walk into an operational review and change the conversation.
That's a different skill set — and it can be taught.

## How we build your finance capability.
- Leadership Development: one-on-one executive coaching and team-based workshops on influence,
  communication and commercial thinking.
- Finance Business Partner Academy: the flagship five-module programme that closes the gap between
  technical accounting competence and genuine business partnering.

## Built for the real-world pressures finance teams face.
- Delivered in formats that work around busy schedules and distributed teams.
- Content grounded in real finance scenarios — not generic MBA theory.
- Facilitated by people who have worked in the roles your leaders hold.

# Leadership development for finance professionals.

Beyond technical competence. Most finance leaders are promoted for being technically excellent, then
expected to influence strategy, manage stakeholders and lead through uncertainty — with no training for
any of it. We fix that.

## How we work with you.
- One-on-one executive coaching: for senior finance leaders navigating complexity, transitions or new
  roles. Structured over three to six months.
- Team-based leadership workshops: half-day or full-day sessions on influence, communication and
  commercial thinking.
- Finance Business Partner Academy: the flagship five-module programme.

## Built for the real-world pressures finance teams face.
- Delivered in formats that work around busy schedules and distributed teams.
- Content grounded in real finance scenarios — not generic MBA theory.
- Facilitated by people who have worked in the roles your leaders hold.

## Common questions
Q: How do I upskill my finance team?
A: StratumCore runs practical leadership development for finance professionals — one-on-one executive
coaching and team-based workshops on influence, communication and commercial thinking. It works for
finance teams in any industry.

Q: What is the difference between technical finance skills and leadership?
A: Most finance professionals are promoted for being technically excellent, then expected to influence
strategy and lead through uncertainty with no training for it. We build the skills to walk into an
operational review and change the conversation, not just report on it.

Q: How is the coaching delivered?
A: One-on-one coaching is structured over three to six months with a clear development agenda from the
first session. Workshops are half-day or full-day, around busy schedules and distributed teams.

Q: Who is leadership development for?
A: Senior finance leaders navigating complexity or new roles, and finance teams that need to work better
with the business rather than just within it.

# Finance Business Partner Academy.

Five modules. One clear outcome: finance that drives decisions. A structured programme for finance
professionals in any industry who want to move beyond reporting and into genuine commercial influence.

## What you'll work through.
1. Financial Storytelling — turn data into narrative that lands with operational and executive audiences.
2. Influencing Without Authority — drive decisions even when you don't hold the budget.
3. Value Driver Trees — map what actually moves the business and connect finance to value creation.
4. Diagnostic Problem Solving — structured problem-solving for commercial and operational challenges.
5. Planning & Execution — planning processes that reflect operational reality, not just accounting periods.

## Taught the way finance leaders actually learn.
- Real-world case-study method, grounded in decisions made under pressure.
- Real-world context: scenarios and language drawn from real operations and commercial decisions.
- Applied, not academic: every module ends with a tool or framework the team can use immediately.

## Who it's for and how it's run.
Ideal for finance managers stepping into business partner roles, CFOs building team capability, and
finance teams in any industry or sector. Delivered as an in-house cohort, an open mixed-company cohort, or
individual modules as standalone workshops.

## Common questions
Q: How do I train my finance team to become finance business partners?
A: The Finance Business Partner Academy is a structured five-module programme that closes the gap between
technical accounting competence and genuine business partnering. It covers financial storytelling,
influencing without authority, value driver trees, diagnostic problem solving, and planning and execution.

Q: What does the FBP Academy cover?
A: Five sequenced modules, each ending with a tool or framework your team can use immediately. Modules use
a real-world, case-study method.

Q: How is the Academy delivered?
A: As an in-house cohort for your team, an open mixed-company cohort, or as individual modules run as
standalone workshops.

Q: Who is the FBP Academy for?
A: Finance managers stepping into business partner roles, CFOs building team capability, and finance teams
in any industry or sector.

# StratumCore: finance advisory built by people who have done the job.

StratumCore is an independent advisory partnership. No junior consultants. No templated solutions.

Finance and transformation leader across large asset-intensive organisations in mining and industrial

Secretary (AGIA), Bachelor of Commerce in Professional Accounting and Finance, and Harvard Business School
alumnus. Previously BHP, Wesfarmers, BUMA, Ernst & Young. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/wenkhong/

Extensive experience across commercial strategy, operational performance and major contract negotiations
within large mining and industrial organisations. MBA (The University of Queensland), Certified Practising
Accountant (CPA), Bachelor of Commerce in Accounting and Finance. Previously BMA, BHP, Bankwest, CS Gas.
